name: AGENTS
summary: Talk to the seats on this box. The rig roster, live, with a way to actually say something.

surface.hint: the seats on this box, and a way to talk to them

run._note: Root KINDS, bound at install. The box supplies the paths; this provider never names one.

companions.label: live rig state
companions._note: Generates the box's REAL observe-state from the running rig, replacing the SDK's shipped demo fixture. Declaring {{state}} is what points the runtime here. Without it a deployed studio renders an invented rig under a live dot, and on a box with no rig at all this writes an explicit no-rig state rather than leaving the fiction on screen.

provider._note: These verbs were special-cased as requires.host_capabilities and served by a private box, so this app installed onto a public studio and rendered an EMPTY PANE. It is an ordinary provider now.
